# Emmett Till Exhibit

> > A touring educational exhibit documenting the 1955 lynching of Emmett Till and Mamie Till-Mobley's civil rights activism, presented by the Emmett Till and Mamie Till-Mobley Institute.

This traveling exhibit has been hosted at institutions including The Children's Museum of Indianapolis, Spencer Museum of Art, Northwest African American Museum, and National Underground Railroad Freedom Center. The exhibit provides historical education on Jim Crow South violence, the civil rights movement, and contemporary racial justice activism through museum displays, educational resources, and community engagement tools.
